mcp_tools.name: certify
mcp_tools.description: Spawn `bin/mini-ork certify --json` against base..head in the project root (timeout MO_MCP_CERTIFY_TIMEOUT_S, default 900). Returns the parsed certificate plus exit_code on JSON output; stdout/stderr tails on non-JSON output.

mcp_tools.name: cost
mcp_tools.description: Cost-per-day rows for the last N days plus a total.

mcp_tools.name: describe_recipe
mcp_tools.description: Everything about one recipe: purpose, request keywords, steps with their model roles, checks, grade with fix hints, track record, files. Returns the card dict; unknown id → error object.

mcp_tools.name: draft_kickoff
mcp_tools.description: Show the user a kickoff before any run starts. It does NOT start a run: the user starts it with a button. Fix every finding of severity error and draft again.

mcp_tools.name: draft_recipe
mcp_tools.description: Render a recipe spec into <home>/recipe-drafts/<id>/ WITHOUT writing into <home>/recipes/. The user must approve before any commit (no commit tool is exposed via MCP). Returns {ok, draft_id, target, exists, files, warnings, grade} on success; {ok: false, errors} on validation failure. The spec object follows recipe_guide().spec_schema; `base` is optional and, when given, must equal the spec's id (editing an existing project recipe).

mcp_tools.name: get_recipe_spec
mcp_tools.description: Return the spec a project or engine recipe was authored from (the parsed <recipe>/recipe.spec.json). Returns {error: ...} when the recipe was hand-edited and not authored from a spec; copy it into the project first to edit it via draft_recipe.

mcp_tools.name: lanes
mcp_tools.description: lane_name → family map from the active agents config.

mcp_tools.name: learnings
mcp_tools.description: Failure-mode gradients (per task_class), emergent patterns, and memory (tasks + agents), each filterable by substring.

mcp_tools.name: list_automations
mcp_tools.description: List every automation in the project: id, name, recipe, schedule, when (human description), enabled, workspace, next_fire (ISO, null when paused), last_run, runs (audit). Plus the OS scheduler status. Read-only.

mcp_tools.name: list_recipes
mcp_tools.description: List recipes visible to the current project. Each entry covers either an engine recipe (under <engine_root>/recipes/) or a project recipe (under <home>/recipes/); a project recipe with the same id as an engine recipe wins on the name clash and the engine one is omitted. Returns {id, description, source, nodes, overrides_engine?} per recipe.

mcp_tools.name: list_runs
mcp_tools.description: List mini-ork runs newest-first (id, status, recipe, cost, created_at, derived title). Read-only. ``total`` is the number of matching runs; ``runs`` holds at most ``limit`` (default 20).

mcp_tools.name: propose_automation
mcp_tools.description: Propose a scheduled run of a recipe. This does NOT schedule anything: the user sees the proposal and creates it with a button. Schedule is a 5-field cron string in local time (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week; 0 = Sunday), e.g. `0 9 * * 1-5` = every weekday at 09:00. Calling it again with the same id replaces the proposal.

mcp_tools.name: recipe_guide
mcp_tools.description: Describe what a recipe spec looks like: JSON schema, step types, the home's lane map, short authoring rules, and an example. Read-only; no project state changes. Returns {spec_schema, step_types, roles, rules, example}.

mcp_tools.name: run_detail
mcp_tools.description: Full task_runs row + node lifecycle events + first 2000 chars of the kickoff + verdict.json for a single run_id.

mcp_tools.name: run_status
mcp_tools.description: Snapshot of a single run: status, recipe, cost_usd, and per-node state derived from node_start/node_end lifecycle events.

mcp_tools.name: start_run
mcp_tools.description: Launch a new mini-ork run via `bin/mini-ork run <recipe> <kickoff>`. Sets MO_TARGET_CWD to the project root so the spawned run operates on the user's checkout. Returns {ok, run_id, recipe, pid, kickoff_path, log_path} on success or {error} on failure.

mcp_tools.name: stop_run
mcp_tools.description: Stop a running task. soft (hard=false) writes a stop-requested flag the dispatcher honours before the next node; hard (hard=true) SIGTERMs then SIGKILLs the dispatcher pid.

mcp_tools.name: wait_for_run
mcp_tools.description: Poll run_status until the run reaches a terminal state (published, rolled_back, failed, not_needed) or timeout_s passes. timeout_s is clamped to [30, 1800] (default 600). Returns the last status plus {terminal, waited_s}; when terminal, includes verdict.json and the last 30 lines of the launch log.

mcp_tools.name: workspaces
mcp_tools.description: List open task-isolation workspaces (Zed S4). Each row carries the workspace's branch / base / path plus a status snapshot (commits_ahead, uncommitted, added, removed, files). Read-only — Merge / Discard live in a later slice.
